title: Global Tensions Rise This Week

slides.headline: Global Tensions Rise This Week
slides.subtitle: Five quick updates on the world events shaping the coming days.

slides.headline: Trump Names New White House Counsel
slides.explanation: President Trump has appointed staff secretary Will Scharf as his new White House counsel. This role is a key position for managing the administration's legal strategy.

slides.headline: Houthi Attack Hits Saudi Refinery
slides.explanation: Yemen’s Houthi rebels have claimed responsibility for a drone strike on a Saudi Arabian oil refinery. This escalation follows a new defense agreement between Saudi Arabia and Turkey.

slides.headline: Germany Reports Constant Hybrid Warfare
slides.explanation: Germany’s interior minister says the country is facing daily sabotage and espionage attempts. Authorities are warning that these covert operations have become a constant reality.

slides.headline: Italy and Spain Clash Over Borders
slides.explanation: Italy has slammed Spain for implementing new, retaliatory border checks on Italian travelers. The move is a major escalation in an ongoing dispute over migration policies.

slides.headline: Crime Boss Kinahan Faces Dublin Court
slides.explanation: Suspected crime boss Daniel Kinahan appeared in a Dublin court after being extradited from Dubai. He is facing charges related to leading a criminal organization.

caption:
From rising tensions in the Middle East to legal battles in Ireland, the global landscape is shifting quickly today. We have broken down the five most important geopolitical headlines you need to know. Which of these stories do you think will have the biggest impact this week?

title: Tech News You Need Today

slides.headline: Tech News You Need Today
slides.subtitle: From Tesla crashes to yacht rescues, here is what is happening in tech right now.

slides.headline: A Big Bet on AI Chips
slides.explanation: Hedge fund Situational Awareness is investing $400 million into a chip startup called Source Foundry. This shows that despite market uncertainty, major investors are still funneling massive cash into AI hardware.

slides.headline: 49ers Coach Discusses Tesla Crash
slides.explanation: Coach Kyle Shanahan revealed that his Tesla was on Autopilot during a recent car accident near Palo Alto. It highlights the ongoing questions about driver assistance technology and human responsibility behind the wheel.

slides.headline: The Future of Robotaxis
slides.explanation: Zoox is gearing up for a new launch as Uber continues to build its autonomous vehicle network. This is a sign that the race to automate transportation is heating up in major cities.

slides.headline: Top Gear for Your Workout
slides.explanation: Wired tested the latest headphones from brands like Beats, Bose, and Apple to see which ones actually handle a gym session. Finding the right pair matters because fit and durability are just as important as sound quality.

slides.headline: Zuckerberg's Yacht and a Rescue
slides.explanation: A cruise ship rescued a stranded boat while Mark Zuckerberg's super yacht was actually closer to the scene. It is a reminder that even when billionaires are nearby, they are not always the ones responding to local emergencies.

caption:
From high-stakes chip investments to the realities of Tesla's Autopilot, today's tech news is a mixed bag. We broke down the most interesting stories so you can stay informed in under a minute. Which of these updates surprised you the most?
